label: TESY BWWP RS485
info: Passively reads the RS485 frames of the TESY Aquathermica Pro (BWWP) via a Waveshare RS485-to-Ethernet gateway -> MQTT -> Home Assistant

name: Decode + HA Discovery
only on 'online'
func:
if (String(msg.payload) !== 'online') return null;
return { topic: 'discover', payload: 'ha-online' };
